about_short_description.short_description: Jaleesa is a marketplace that connects parents with trained & certified babysitters in the local area.

product.name: Babysitting Marketplace Platform
product.description: An online platform connecting parents with trained and certified babysitters in their local area for hourly or monthly childcare services.

product.name: Babysitter Qualification and Training Program
product.description: A structured multi-stage qualification and training process for babysitters to ensure safety, skills, and suitability for childcare roles.

product.name: Babysitting Service Delivery
product.description: Provision of childcare services by babysitters either at the babysitter's home or the parent's chosen location, including homes, workplaces, or public venues.

product.name: Corporate Childcare Solutions
product.description: Childcare services tailored for businesses to comply with labor regulations requiring childcare facilities for female employees, offered as an alternative to establishing new daycare centers.

product.name: Mobile Application for Babysitting Services
product.description: A smartphone application enabling parents to locate, book, and communicate with babysitters, and allowing babysitters to manage their availability and bookings.
